atAGlance: Cơm tôm rim is rice with shrimp simmered in a sticky salty-sweet fish-sauce caramel. It is small, punchy, and rice-hungry.
whatItIs: Cơm tôm rim is rice with shrimp simmered until glossy in a sweet-salty fish-sauce caramel. The shrimp may be shell-on, which gives the glaze deeper seafood flavor.
howToEnjoy: Spoon the shrimp glaze into the rice a little at a time, and check whether the shells are meant to be peeled. Pickles or cucumber help cut the sweetness.
howLocalsOrder: Order cơm tôm rim when you want a savory shrimp rice plate. Ask còn vỏ không if you want to know whether shells remain, and ask for extra rice if the glaze is rich.
worthKnowing: Rim means simmered down until concentrated; on shrimp it creates a sticky, salty-sweet coating that Vietnamese rice is perfect for catching.
goodToKnow: Rim means simmered down until the fish-sauce caramel braise clings. This is not a saucy curry or soup.
